card: Adds functional test coverage for the getblockfilter RPC error path when queried with a block hash for which only the header is known. It exercises the specific error branch returning error -5 indicating the block was not connected to the active chain by using submitheader across disconnected nodes. The author identified this gap via test coverage reports on BIP 157/158 code paths. No other PRs depend on this change.
changed_since_previous: No functional differences; the full diff is now provided confirming the exact test implementation in test/functional/rpc_getblockfilter.py.
evidence: Author notes: "This gap in test coverage was identified by a coverage report generated while exploring BIP 157/158. The branch in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp was never executed in the measured tests: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/64cf455b481d36182957bdcfcae7c411a7879897/src/rpc/blockchain.cpp#L3054-L3056"
problem: The branch in `getblockfilter` in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` that handles blocks that are known by header but were never connected was completely unexercised by existing functional tests.

risk.why: Only touches a functional test script; a bug could cause test flakiness or false failures in CI.

summary: Adds functional test coverage for the `getblockfilter` RPC when querying a block hash whose header is known but whose full block was never connected. The test disconnects two nodes, mines a block on one node, submits only the header to the other node via `submitheader`, and verifies that `getblockfilter` raises RPC error -5 with "Filter not found. Block was not connected to active chain."
